title: Classic Simple Solitaire Engagement Ring in 14K Yellow Gold
supports: Product page identifies stock number 502120y14, lists Metal as 14K Yellow Gold, and displays $1,145 (Setting Price). The page also says a diamond is selected in a later step, so this is not a complete ring price.

title: Blue Nile 30-Day Return Policy
supports: Seller policy says eligible items may be returned in original, unworn condition within 30 days of shipment. It excludes personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, and items resized after initial purchase. This supports the seller's stated terms only; confirm any independent testing with the seller before purchase.
sourceType: Seller policy; current terms can change

title: Contact Blue Nile
supports: The seller page displays a customer-service telephone number and an email contact option. This verifies that the official site publishes contact channels, not that a call/email was independently tested or that seller conduct is satisfactory.
sourceType: Seller contact page; contact channels listed

title: Blue Nile Inc — BBB customer reviews
supports: BBB's profile displayed an average of 1/5 stars across 25 customer reviews and identified the profile as BBB Accredited / A+ rated at access time. Reviews are customer-submitted accounts and the rating is BBB's own system, not a government or product-quality certification.

title: Blue Nile Inc — BBB complaints
supports: BBB's Blue Nile Inc profile displayed 121 complaints in the prior 3 years and 23 in the prior 12 months at access time. sourceType: Independent third-party complaint counts; not findings of liability

title: LBMA Precious Metal Prices — benchmark information
supports: LBMA states its gold benchmark is set in two daily auctions administered by ICE Benchmark Administration. The page notes historical tabulated data moved to a licensed portal; the review page returned no numeric gold quote. This source establishes how the benchmark is administered, not a current price value.

title: 16 CFR Part 23 — Guides for the Jewelry, Precious Metals, and Pewter Industries
supports: Primary U.S. government source for the current Jewelry Guides, including guidance on representations about gold content and quality marks. The eCFR page labels its content authoritative but unofficial; the Guides are guidance, not proof of a particular ring's composition.
